# SwivelGrid — Full API Reference
> Source: API_REFERENCE.md — embedded for LLM/agent consumption without requiring link-following.
> Primary context file: https://swivelgrid.thanish.com/llms.txt

# SwivelGrid API Reference

Complete reference for every public method, property, event, and schema field.

---

## SwivelGrid (Core Web Component)

`SwivelGrid` is a native Web Component (`<swivel-grid>`). Register it by including `SwivelGrid.js` — the class self-registers via `customElements.define`.

### HTML Attributes

| Attribute | Accepted values | Notes |
|-----------|----------------|-------|
| `layout-type` | `"grid"` \| `"table"` | Sets layout mode. Ignored if the `layoutType` property has already been set programmatically. |
| `schema` | JSON array string | Parsed once on connect. Property setter takes precedence. |
| `rows` | JSON array string | Parsed once on connect. Property setter takes precedence. |
| `search-input` | CSS selector string | Binds to an external `<input>` for search (requires SearchExtension). |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Side-effects |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `layoutType` | `string` | `'grid'` | Sets `_layoutType` (normalises `'list'` → `'table'`). Marks `_propSet.layoutType = true`. Does **not** auto-render. |
| `schema` | `Array` | `[]` | Processes each column via TemplateExtension (if loaded). Triggers `render()`. |
| `rows` | `Array` | `[]` | Stores a copy of the array. Triggers `render()`. |
| `searchInput` | `string` | `null` | Delegates to `SearchExtension.bindSearchInput()` if loaded. |
| `sortHandler` | `Function\|null` | `null` | Called by SortingExtension with `{ key, direction }` when a column is sorted. Non-function values are coerced to `null`. |
| `searchHandler` | `Function\|null` | `null` | Called by SearchExtension with the query string when a search fires. |

### Extension Management

```js
el.registerExtension(extension)         // → boolean
el.unregisterExtension(extensionName)   // → boolean
el.getExtension(extensionName)          // → BaseExtension | null
el.hasExtension(extensionName)          // → boolean
el.listExtensions()                     // → string[]
el.swapExtension(name, newInstance)     // → boolean
el.toggleExtension(name, enabled, rerender?) // → boolean
```

#### `registerExtension(extension)` → `boolean`
Registers a `BaseExtension` instance. Calls `extension.initialize(this)`, inserts the extension into `beforeRender` and `afterRender` hook arrays sorted by `extension.priority` (ascending). Returns `false` if the extension has no `name` or a same-named extension is already registered.

#### `unregisterExtension(extensionName)` → `boolean`
Removes the extension from the map and hooks, then calls `extension.destroy()`. Returns `false` if no extension with that name exists.

#### `getExtension(extensionName)` → `BaseExtension | null`
Returns the registered extension instance or `null`.

#### `hasExtension(extensionName)` → `boolean`

#### `listExtensions()` → `string[]`
Returns extension names in registration order.

#### `swapExtension(name, newExtensionInstance)` → `boolean`
Hot-replaces the named extension without touching other registered extensions. Calls `unregisterExtension(name)` (no-op if not found), then `registerExtension(newExtensionInstance)`. Returns the result of the `registerExtension` call.

#### `toggleExtension(name, enabled, rerender = true)` → `boolean`
Calls `extension.setEnabled(enabled)`. If `rerender` is `true` (default), calls `this.render()`. Returns `false` if extension not found.

### Data Methods

#### `setData(rows)` → `void`
Replaces `_rows` and calls `PaginationExtension.resetPaginationState()` (if loaded), then `render()`. Dispatches `swivel:data` event.

#### `render()` → `void`
Executes all `beforeRender` hooks in priority order, sets `shadowRoot.innerHTML` to `context.layoutHTML`, then executes all `afterRender` hooks.

#### `destroy()` → `void`
Calls `extension.destroy()` on every registered extension, clears `_extensions` map, empties hook arrays.

### Style & Event Utilities

#### `addExtensionStyles(css, id)` → `boolean`
Injects a `<style data-extension-id="id">` tag into the shadow DOM. Safe to call multiple times — replaces existing style with same `id`.

#### `removeExtensionStyles(id)` → `boolean`
Removes the `<style>` with the matching `data-extension-id`.

#### `addExtensionEventListener(eventName, handler, extensionName)` → `Function`
Registers a DOM event listener on the grid element and tracks it under `extensionName` for bulk cleanup. Returns a cleanup function.

#### `cleanupExtensionEventListeners(extensionName)` → `void`
Removes all listeners registered under `extensionName`.

#### `dispatchExtensionEvent(type, detail)` → `void`
Fires a `CustomEvent` named `swivel:${type}` (bubbles, composed).

#### `getDOMElements()` → `Object`
Returns `{ tbody?, gridContainer? }` — live references to key shadow DOM elements.

### Events

All events bubble and are composed (cross shadow DOM boundary).

| Event | Fired by | `event.detail` |
|-------|----------|---------------|
| `swivel:sort` | SortingExtension | `{ key: string, direction: 'ASC'|'DESC' }` |
| `swivel:search` | SearchExtension | `{ query: string }` |
| `swivel:pageThreshold` | PaginationExtension | `{ currentPage: number, visibleEndIndex: number }` |
| `swivel:data` | SwivelGrid core | `{ rows: Array }` |

---

## BaseExtension

The base class all extensions extend.

```js
import { BaseExtension } from './extensions/BaseExtension.js';

class MyExtension extends BaseExtension {
    constructor() { super('my-extension'); }
    onAfterRender(context, el) { /* ... */ }
}
```

### Constructor

```js
new BaseExtension(name)
```

`name` — unique string identifier used by `grid.getExtension(name)`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | (required) | Extension identifier |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, all lifecycle hooks are skipped |
| `priority` | `number` | `0` | Lower = earlier execution in hook queue |

### Lifecycle Hooks (override these)

```js
onInitialize(gridInstance)              // called once on registerExtension
onBeforeRender(context) → context       // must return context
onAfterRender(context, renderedElement) // DOM is live
onDestroy()                             // called on unregisterExtension / grid.destroy()
```

`onBeforeRender` receives and must return the context object (see [Context Object](#context-object)).

### Utility Methods (available inside hooks)

```js
this.getGrid()                          // → SwivelGrid instance
this.getGridState()                     // → GridState object
this.dispatchEvent(eventName, detail?)  // fires swivel:eventName
this.setEnabled(bool)                   // toggles .enabled
this.setPriority(number)                // updates .priority
```

### Context Object

Passed to every `onBeforeRender` call. Must be returned.

```js
{
  schema:      Array,   // processed column definitions
  rows:        Array,   // current row data
  layoutType:  string,  // 'grid' | 'table'
  searchInput: string,  // CSS selector for bound search input (or null)
  layoutHTML:  string   // HTML string; set by LayoutRendererExtension
}
```

### GridState Object

Returned by `this.getGridState()`.

```js
{
  schema:      Array,
  rows:        Array,
  layoutType:  string,
  searchInput: string,
  loading:     boolean,       // PaginationExtension state (or false)
  currentPage: number,        // PaginationExtension state (or 1)
  pageSize:    number,        // PaginationExtension state (or null)
  totalPages:  number|null    // PaginationExtension state (or null)
}
```

---

## BundleBuilder

Chainable utility for composing custom extension bundles with dependency resolution and size estimation.

```js
const instances = new BundleBuilder()
    .addFeature('sorting')
    .addFeature('search')
    .build();                   // → [LayoutRendererExtension, SortingExtension, SearchExtension]

instances.forEach(ext => grid.registerExtension(ext));
```

### Constructor

```js
new BundleBuilder()
```

### Chainable Feature Methods

#### `addFeature(name, config?)` → `this`
Adds a feature by name. Duplicate calls are idempotent.  
`config` is passed to the extension constructor on `build()`.

#### `removeFeature(name)` → `this`

#### `withConfig(featureName, config)` → `this`
Merges `config` into the stored config for an already-added feature.

#### `hasFeature(name)` → `boolean`

### Processing Methods

#### `resolveDependencies()` → `{ resolved: string[], added: string[] }`
Auto-adds any missing dependencies to the feature list. Mutates internal state. Call before `validate()` / `build()` if you want the check to pass without manually adding deps.

#### `validate()` → `{ valid: boolean, errors: string[] }`
Validates the current feature set without building. Checks for unknown names, missing deps, and conflicts.

#### `estimateSize()` → `{ kb: number, breakdown: Object }`
Returns estimated minified KB for the current feature set based on static size constants.

```js
{ kb: 12, breakdown: { 'layout-renderer': 8, 'sorting': 4 } }
```

### Build Method

#### `build()` → `BaseExtension[]`
Calls `resolveDependencies()`, validates, instantiates all extension classes from global scope, and returns them sorted by priority. **Throws** if validation fails or an extension class is not found in global scope.

### Serialization

#### `toConfig()` → `{ version: 1, features: Array }`
Returns a plain JSON-serializable object. Store it and restore with `fromConfig`.

#### `static BundleBuilder.fromConfig(configObj)` → `BundleBuilder`
Restores a builder from a `toConfig()` output. Throws if `configObj` is null or lacks a `features` array.

#### `static BundleBuilder.fromPreset(presetName)` → `BundleBuilder`
Creates a builder pre-populated from one of the six named presets. Throws if preset name is unknown.

### Available Features

| Feature name | Extension class | Est. KB | Requires |
|---|---|---|---|
| `'layout-renderer'` | `LayoutRendererExtension` | 8 | — |
| `'templates'` | `TemplateExtension` | 5 | — |
| `'sorting'` | `SortingExtension` | 4 | `layout-renderer` |
| `'search'` | `SearchExtension` | 3 | `layout-renderer` |
| `'pagination'` | `PaginationExtension` | 6 | `layout-renderer` |
| `'css-classes'` | `CssClassesExtension` | 3 | `layout-renderer` |
| `'accessibility'` | `AccessibilityExtension` | 4 | `layout-renderer` |

### Presets

| Preset name | Features |
|---|---|
| `'table-focused'` | layout-renderer, sorting, search, pagination |
| `'designer'` | layout-renderer, templates, css-classes |
| `'data-heavy'` | layout-renderer, templates, pagination, search |
| `'minimal-interactive'` | layout-renderer, sorting |
| `'dashboard'` | layout-renderer, templates, css-classes |
| `'enterprise'` | layout-renderer, templates, sorting, search, pagination, css-classes, accessibility |

---

## BundleLoader

Orchestrates loading bundles, presets, and use-case configurations into a grid.

All async load methods return:
```js
{ success: boolean, loadedExtensions: string[], errors: string[] }
```

### Instance Methods

#### `async loadBundle(gridInstance, bundleName, options?)` → `Promise<Result>`
`bundleName`: `'standard'` | `'advanced'`

#### `async loadForUseCase(gridInstance, useCase, options?)` → `Promise<Result>`
Maps a use case string to a bundle or preset and loads it.

**Valid use case strings:**

| Use case | Loads |
|----------|-------|
| `'data-table'` | standard bundle |
| `'sortable-list'` | standard bundle |
| `'product-catalog'` | standard bundle |
| `'user-listing'` | standard bundle |
| `'minimal'` | advanced / `minimal-interactive` preset |
| `'dashboard'` | advanced / `dashboard` preset |
| `'content-management'` | advanced / `table-focused` preset |
| `'analytics'` | advanced / `data-heavy` preset |
| `'admin-interface'` | advanced / `enterprise` preset |
| `'enterprise'` | advanced / `enterprise` preset |

#### `async loadPreset(gridInstance, presetName, options?)` → `Promise<Result>`
Loads one of the six named presets (see [Presets](#presets) table above).

#### `async loadCustom(gridInstance, extensionNames, options?)` → `Promise<Result>`
Loads an arbitrary subset of extension names. No dependency resolution — list all needed names explicitly.

#### `async loadFromConfig(gridInstance, configObj, options?)` → `Promise<Result>`
Restores a `BundleBuilder.toConfig()` output and loads the resulting extensions.

#### `recommendBundle(requirements)` → `Recommendation`
```js
// requirements fields (all boolean, all optional):
{
  needsSorting:        false,
  needsSearch:         false,
  needsPagination:     false,
  needsTemplates:      false,
  needsAccessibility:  false,
  needsCustomStyling:  false,
  prioritizeSize:      false   // prefer smaller bundle
}
// returns:
{
  bundle: string,
  preset: string | null,
  reason: string,
  estimatedSize: string,
  features: string[]
}
```

#### `getBundleInfo()` → `Object`  
Returns metadata for both bundles (name, version, extensions list, estimated size, use cases).

#### `getPresets()` → `Object`  
Returns `{ presetName: string[] }` mapping.

#### `getUseCaseRecommendations()` → `Object`  
Returns `{ useCaseName: { bundle, preset?, description, extensions[] } }`.

#### `getBundleSizes()` → `Object`  
Returns `{ 'core-only': {...}, 'standard': {...}, 'advanced': {...} }` with `estimatedSize` and `lineCount` strings.

#### `checkCompatibility(gridInstance, bundleName)` → `{ compatible: boolean, issues: string[] }`

#### `getLoadHistory()` → `Array`  
Each entry: `{ timestamp, bundleName, gridId, success, extensionsLoaded }`.

#### `clearLoadHistory()` → `void`

### Static Methods

```js
BundleLoader.quickLoad(gridInstance, bundleName, options?)          // → Promise<Result>
BundleLoader.quickLoadForUseCase(gridInstance, useCase, options?)   // → Promise<Result>
BundleLoader.loadFromConfig(gridInstance, configObj, options?)      // → Promise<Result>
```

---

## ExtensionLoader

Manages loading and unloading extensions programmatically.

### Constructor

```js
const loader = new ExtensionLoader();
```

### Preset Setup Methods

#### `loadMinimalSetup(grid)` → `string[]`
Registers `layout-renderer` only. Returns `['layout-renderer']`.

#### `loadStandardSetup(grid)` → `string[]`
Registers `layout-renderer`, `templates`, `sorting`. Returns array of loaded names.

#### `loadAdvancedSetup(grid)` → `string[]`
Registers all 7 extensions in priority order. Returns array of loaded names.

### Custom Loading

#### `loadCustomBundle(grid, featureList, config?)` → `{ loaded, skipped, errors }`
Uses `BundleBuilder` to resolve dependencies before loading. `config` is an object keyed by feature name.
- `loaded` — extension names registered in this call
- `skipped` — names already registered on the grid (not re-registered)
- `errors` — validation or registration failures

#### `createCustomSetup(grid, configObj)` → `{ loaded, skipped, errors }`
Equivalent to `loadCustomBundle` but takes a `BundleBuilder.toConfig()` object as input.

#### `async lazyLoad(grid, extensionPath, config?)` → `Promise<boolean>`
Dynamically `import()`s a module from `extensionPath`, extracts the default or first exported class, instantiates it with `config`, and registers it. Returns `true` on success.

### Per-Extension Methods

#### `loadExtension(grid, Extension, config?)` → `boolean`
`Extension` may be a constructor function or an already-instantiated instance.

#### `loadExtensions(grid, extensions)` → `string[]`
`extensions` is an array of `{ Extension, name?, config?, priority? }` objects.

#### `unloadExtension(grid, extensionName)` → `boolean`

#### `unloadAllExtensions(grid)` → `number`
Returns the count of extensions unloaded.

### Inspection & Control

#### `getExtensionInfo(extensionName)` → `{ name, enabled, priority, type } | null`

#### `listLoadedExtensions()` → `Array<{ name, enabled, priority, type }>`

#### `setExtensionEnabled(extensionName, enabled)` → `boolean`

#### `setExtensionPriority(extensionName, priority)` → `boolean`

---

## Schema Column Definition

Each object in the `schema` array may have the following fields:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `key` | `string` | **required** | Maps to the row data property name |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Column header text |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether clicking the header triggers sort |
| `sort` | `'ASC'` \| `'DESC'` \| `undefined` | `undefined` | Initial sort direction; set by SortingExtension after sort |
| `sortComparator` | `Function` | `undefined` | Custom comparator `(a, b, rowA, rowB) → number` |
| `cellTemplate` | `string` | `undefined` | Handlebars-style template string for cell content |
| `headerTemplate` | `string` | `undefined` | Template string for header cell content |
| `cellClass` | `string` | `undefined` | CSS class(es) applied to the cell wrapper `<span>` (requires CssClassesExtension) |
| `headerClass` | `string` | `undefined` | CSS class(es) applied to the `<th>` (requires CssClassesExtension) |
| `rowClass` | `string\|Function` | `undefined` | CSS class added to `<tr>`. If a function: `(row) → string` |
| `type` | `string` | `undefined` | **Deprecated.** `'rating'` or `'image'` — use `cellTemplate` instead |
| `width` | `string` | `undefined` | CSS width value applied as inline style to `<th>` and `<td>` |
| `minWidth` | `string` | `undefined` | CSS min-width value |

### Template Variables

Templates are `{{variable}}` style. Available variables inside a `cellTemplate`:
- `{{value}}` — the raw cell value
- `{{row.fieldName}}` — any field from the current row object
- `{{renderRating(value)}}` — render a star rating
- `{{renderImage(value)}}` — render an `<img>` tag
- `{{formatDate(value)}}` — format a date string
- `{{formatNumber(value)}}` — format a number
- `{{formatCurrency(value)}}` — format as currency
- `{{capitalize(value)}}` — capitalize first letter
- `{{truncate(value, 50)}}` — truncate to N characters

---

## Extension Priority Reference

| Extension | Priority | Why |
|-----------|----------|-----|
| PaginationExtension | 5 | Must inject `pageSize`/`totalPages` setters before schema/rows are set |
| LayoutRendererExtension | 10 | Must generate `layoutHTML` before other hooks read the DOM |
| TemplateExtension | 20 | Processes schema templates before rendering |
| SortingExtension | 30 | Reads `layoutHTML` already set; attaches listeners in `afterRender` |
| SearchExtension | 40 | Binds to external input after render |
| CssClassesExtension | 50 | Applies CSS classes to already-rendered cells in `afterRender` |
| AccessibilityExtension | 100 | Adds ARIA attributes to fully-rendered DOM last |
